PB GRENADE.description:
The PB Grenade is great for area-denial thanks to its nearly 7 second fuse time, though the overall killing radius is somewhat low. It possesses an extremely high overall blast radius and is almost guaranteed to achieve some kind of effect.
I hear there is a helicopter coming to rescue us survivors from Mercy hospital...
PB GRENADE.name: PB GRENADE

M26 FRAG.description: A Grand Federation grenade that saw use in the Seongho War and preceeded the M67 grenade. Featuring similar performance, however slightly less throwing speed but its shape offers a lot more bounce.
M26 FRAG.name: M26 FRAG

RGD-5 HE.description: A large high-explosive grenade with a short fuse time, making it the perfect anti-personnel grenade. However, the grenade is larger and heavier than average, reducing the number you can carry and how far it can be thrown.
RGD-5 HE.name: RGD-5 HE

RGO UDZS.description:
A defensive hand grenade with the UDZS dual-fuze. It will detonate on impact, but only after a time-delay of 1s has passed. Otherwise, it will function like a normal frag grenade and bounce.

Note: cooking the grenade does not bypass the impact fuse.
RGO UDZS.name: RGO UDZS

M560 MINI.description: A Grand Federation mini-grenade by Accuracy Systems. It was intended to serve as a modern replacement to the then popular V40 mini-grenade, however this series was short lived. Fast throw speed and reasonable blast radius.
M560 MINI.name: M560 MINI

FRAG.description: A traditional Grand Federation grenade. Moderate arc with a moderate blast radius and kill range.
FRAG.name: FRAG

M24 STICK.description: A grenade colloquially known as the potato masher. The stick based design allows it to be used effectively as an offensive grenade. Slightly shorter fuse and slightly below average blast radius.
M24 STICK.name: M24 STICK

T-13 IMPACT.description:
A small baseball-shaped grenade that detonates on impact with a hard surface.

Doesn't do a lot of damage, but you can carry a lot of them and throw them very far!
T-13 IMPACT.name: T-13 IMPACT

DYNAMITE.description:
An explosive developed for mining in the late 1800s, not to be confused with TNT.

Reasonable killing radius and exceptional carrying capacity, but relatively slow to arm and a low wounding radius relative to the killing radius thanks to the lack of any fragmentation.
DYNAMITE.name: DYNAMITE

RGN UDZS.description:
An offensive hand grenade with the UDZS dual-fuze. It will detonate on impact, but only after a time-delay of 1.2s has passed. Otherwise, it will function like a normal frag grenade and bounce.

I'm sure you'll still find a way to blow yourself up with this, right?

Note: cooking the grenade does not bypass the impact fuse.
RGN UDZS.name: RGN UDZS

SEMTEX.description:
An explosive device which will stick to surfaces when thrown. Above average blast radius and throwing velocity.
Cannot be cooked, and comes with a persistent beeping that will alert foes to its presence.
SEMTEX.name: SEMTEX

MK 2 FRAG.description: An iconic Grand Federation grenade renowned for looking like a pineapple. Due to shrapnel it is very powerful in close range. However, like bullets, damage drops off in range, and this shrapnel behaves a lot like that.
MK 2 FRAG.name: MK 2 FRAG

TYPE 77-1 FRAG.description:
A stick grenade developed from the M24.

Extremely low fuse time and above average carrying capacity, but below average roll and killing radius.

This grenade cannot be cooked in the hand.

Model submitted by Vic.
TYPE 77-1 FRAG.name: TYPE 77-1 FRAG

ROLY HG.description:
ANTI, BRING FORTH THE ROLY HAND GRENADE.

First shalt thou take out the Roly Pin. Then shalt thou count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the number thou shalt count, and the number of the counting shall be three. Four shalt thou not count, neither count thou two, excepting that thou then proceed to three. Five is right out. Once the number three, being the third number, be reached, then lobbest thou thy Roly Hand Grenade of Crane Site towards thy foe, who, being naughty in My sight, shall snuff it.
ROLY HG.name: ROLY HG

V40 MINI.description: A small Havenrijker mini-grenade. This vaguely golf ball shaped grenades small size allows you to throw it to great distances, however you carry more and are less powerful than other grenades.
V40 MINI.name: V40 MINI

BUNDLE CHARGE.description: An Eisenmarkian improvisation of the standard M24 stick grenade. It has six extra charges tied together with a metal wire. This was done to combat lightly armored tanks of the second world war with surprising effectiveness due to its low cost and reliability. However unconventional to carry and a slow charge time.
BUNDLE CHARGE.name: BUNDLE CHARGE

DYNAMITE-3.description:
A bundle of three sticks of dynamite, a personal choice of coyotes and animated characters.

Somewhat larger blast radius than the single stick of dynamite, but still lacks in wounding radius.
The fuse time is also slightly longer.
DYNAMITE-3.name: DYNAMITE-3
